'''2014 European Championship Reset Beta Dennis Schwarz LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Dennis Schwarz]] at [[2014 European Championship Reset Beta]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Dennis Schwarz]]
* '''Event:''' [[2014 European Championship Reset Beta]]
* '''Stage:''' Results
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''Starting Interrupt:''' [[Heading For The Medical Frigate]]
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2014-europeans-reset-beta-event-15th-place-ls-dennis-schwarz-wys/ PC list]
